walk_forward.parameter_fitting: none; fixed grid before outcomes; rolling training windows diagnostic only
walk_forward.continuous_oos: positions carry across adjacent test folds, liquidate only at final exit

combination_grid.rebalance: none; sum actual marked component equity; no transfer between sleeves; fractions specify capital out of 2000 USDT, raw units specify 1000 USDT each

costs.impact: 0.5 * lagged 20-day daily close return volatility * sqrt(reference order notional / lagged 20-day mean daily quote volume)

selection: report full grid; any positive result remains historical candidate requiring future untouched data; no OOS-selected retuning represented as independent confirmation
